intro.title: Smart Point is an engineering and consulting company that helps clients deliver their ambitious projects and solve complex technical challenges.
intro.desc: We specialise in working with industrial and technology companies, offering comprehensive engineering solutions from concept development to full project delivery.
cw.label: Why us
cw.heading: Our key advantages
advantages.heading: Why clients choose Smart Point
advantages.card1_desc: One partner at every stage means saved time and guaranteed consistency of decisions. We offer a full-cycle service — from strategic analysis and feasibility studies to the implementation of innovative technologies and post-project support.
advantages.card2_desc: Universal methods don't work for unique challenges. We develop solutions tailored to a specific business, its characteristics and ambitions. Our goal is measurable results: improved efficiency, revenue growth, sustainable development.
advantages.card3_title: Working with business and the public sector
advantages.card3_desc: Experience delivering projects for both the private sector and government bodies allows us to understand the requirements of both sides and find optimal solutions within different regulatory environments.
company.title: We don't just deliver projects — we build partnerships based on results
company.subtitle: A company that grew alongside its clients
company.text1: Smart Point was founded in 2006 by a group of engineers and consultants who saw the market's need for a comprehensive approach to the delivery of technical projects. We started with small infrastructure projects but quickly expanded our range of services thanks to growing client trust and our ability to find effective solutions to complex challenges.
company.text2: Over two decades of work we have evolved from a local consulting company to a recognised partner in project management, technology transfer and digital transformation. The geography of our projects has expanded beyond Kazakhstan — we have worked with clients from various CIS countries.
company.text3: Today Smart Point's portfolio includes dozens of successfully delivered projects in digitalisation, infrastructure, industry and energy. We continue to grow, adopting modern methodologies while preserving what mattered from day one — accountability for results and partnerships built on trust.

cta.desc: If you need not just a contractor but a partner who is accountable for results — we're ready to talk

services.spacer_lead: Smart Point offers comprehensive consulting services for technical projects of any complexity.
services.spacer_sub: We work at every stage: from strategic planning to post-project support.
services.strategy_heading: A strategy focused on solving your challenges.
services.strategy_bold: Our company's name is linked to the SMART methodology — a system in which every goal is checked for specificity, measurability and achievability.
services.strategy_text: We don't just take on tasks — we structure our work so you know exactly what is being done, by which criteria success is measured, and when results will be delivered.
services.stages_heading: Our services at every project stage
services.stages_text: Every project goes through the following lifecycle stages. We can either manage them fully on your behalf or join at any stage.
services.stage1_desc: We lay the foundation for a successful project from the very start.
services.stage1_list:
• Project design and feasibility study preparation
  • Defining organisational structure and management templates
  • Mediation and facilitation to create maximum opportunities
  • Defining financial structure and funding methods
services.stage2_desc: We develop a detailed concept and solution architecture.
services.stage2_list:
• Creating and maintaining project master plans
  • Detailed development and solution architecture
  • Defining participant roles and business processes
  • Preparing the financing concept
  • Developing the scheduling plan
  • Collecting expert opinions and conclusions
  • Coordinating with all stakeholders
services.stage3_desc: We work through every aspect of implementation down to the finest detail.
services.stage3_list:
• Preparing technical and commercial specifications
  • Time and resource planning
  • Project finance and liquidity planning
  • Implementation process planning
  • Coordination and synchronisation of internal and external projects
services.stage4_desc: We monitor project execution at every stage of rollout.
services.stage4_list:
• Running tenders and selecting contractors
  • Project management and specification compliance control
  • Active budget and cost control
  • Managing participant authority
  • Quality control and documentation
  • On-site organisational and technical implementation
  • Monitoring trial operation
  • Acceptance of sub-projects and final handover
services.stage5_desc: We ensure effective operation after the project launch.
services.stage5_list:
• Process analysis and optimisation
  • Implementing new operational processes
  • Resource planning and management
  • Personnel and materials assignment
  • KPI implementation and management systems
  • Risk analysis and management
  • Audits and certification
  • Staff training on processes and IT systems
